title: Aguachile
description: Aguachile is a dish from Mexico prepared with shrimp, lime juice, serrano pepper, cilantro. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Fully cooked shrimp rather than raw aguachile; lime alone is not a reliable pathogen kill step.

steps.instruction: Poach the shrimp until fully opaque, rinse promptly with cold water, then chill. Lime juice alone does not make raw shrimp reliably safe.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 25 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
